detailed_description: Passport Photo Maker - Calculate passport or visa photo dimensions from a preset or custom millimeter size, DPI, and background choice. The page converts print size into pixel dimensions, reports the aspect ratio, and creates a short checklist covering size, pixels, DPI, and background. It helps prepare specifications, but it does not crop, retouch, or verify an uploaded photo.
usage_steps: Choose a document preset or select custom dimensions
Enter width, height, DPI, and background color when needed
Review pixel size, print size, DPI, aspect ratio, and checklist details
Copy the checklist and compare it with the official document photo rules
usage_examples: Convert a 35 x 45 mm passport photo requirement into pixels at 300 DPI
Compare US passport and EU passport preset dimensions
Create a quick background and size checklist before editing a photo elsewhere

faqs.question: Is the Passport Photo Maker free?
faqs.answer: Yes. The calculator runs in the browser and does not require an account.

faqs.question: Does it edit or crop my photo?
faqs.answer: No. This page calculates dimensions and checklist text. It does not upload, crop, retouch, or validate an image.

faqs.question: Are the presets official requirements?
faqs.answer: Use the presets as a practical reference and always compare the final photo against the current rules from the issuing authority.
